CHANNEL_BINDING.why_the_tools_are_outside: SECRET_GENERATION_CONTRACT.generated_where forbids a repository script that can reach a hosted target (and db/custody/mint-route-b-contract.ts findRepositoryHostedLiveMintScripts enforces it for the mint). The tools therefore live outside every git work tree (each refuses at run time if its own directory has a .git ancestor), and the repository holds their sha256. The certifier reads them at the directory above on the operator workstation.
CHANNEL_BINDING.invalidation: TOOL_BINDING: 'Cualquier cambio posterior invalida la preparación y exige re-evaluación.' A different byte in either tool or in the launcher closure is a different channel: a new pin, a new candidate, a new certification.

CHANNEL_CONTRACT.clauses_source: db/custody/mint-operator-channel.ts OPERATOR_CHANNEL_CONTRACT (the clause text lives in code, next to what it binds; PMR-11 compares these ids with it).
CHANNEL_CONTRACT.channel: The owner (Lorenzo Zanello) runs, from his own console, under bare node, the pinned launcher build with a plan written by the pre-execution gate. The launcher asks for the operator connection string in raw mode (nothing echoed), checks it names N04's host (and, for the mint, the OEP-1-observed principal), and spawns ONE pinned tool with the value only in that tool's environment block (allowlisted environment, windowsHide:false, detached:false, shell:false, secret-free argv). The launcher never writes its process.env, a file, or the value to any stream; its Buffer is zeroed; the one environment string spawn() requires is not zeroable and is disclosed (OF-CUST-1 analogue).
the_value_is_never: in shell history (the keystrokes go to the raw-mode launcher, never to the shell line editor)
CHANNEL_CONTRACT.synthetic_path: Piped input is accepted ONLY when the plan's target is an RFC 6761 .invalid host, so the PEB demonstration can run without a console keystroke and can never reach a real target.

OPERATOR_TOOL_CONTRACT_ADDITIONS.OT-1_at_run_time: Each tool refuses (TOOL_INSIDE_A_GIT_WORK_TREE) if its own directory has a .git ancestor. Measured by the harness scenario TOOL_INSIDE_GIT_TREE on the real tools (the fake-only fixtures are rendered under the OS temp directory, itself inside a git work tree on the authoring workstation, and cannot carry this check).
OPERATOR_TOOL_CONTRACT_ADDITIONS.OT-13: The driver at --driver-root must report postgres 3.4.9 before it is loaded; any other version is refused with no driver call (WRONG_DRIVER_VERSION).
OPERATOR_TOOL_CONTRACT_ADDITIONS.OT-14: The mint tool refuses an operator URL whose user is not --operator-principal, the principal the certified OEP-1 evidence observed (WRONG_OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL).

OEP1_PROBE_CONTRACT.what_it_verifies: Whether the hosted server, in the OPERATOR's session (role-level settings override system ones: docs/ops/p1a/P1A_FULL_BOOTSTRAP_EVIDENCE_v1.0.0.json measured supabase_admin's ROLE-level log_statement), would record the mint's bound parameters or the nested ALTER ROLE the DO block EXECUTEs.

statements.SETTINGS: SELECT name, setting, source FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name = ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY name

OEP1_PROBE_CONTRACT.transaction: ONE, BEGIN READ ONLY; the lists travel only as bound parameters; nothing through unsafe().
OEP1_PROBE_CONTRACT.probe_contract_clauses: PC-1..PC-6 in scripts/custody/d1-oep1-probe-harness.ts (measured on the real probe tool, execution record).
OEP1_PROBE_CONTRACT.verdict_rules: db/custody/mint-operator-channel.ts evaluateOep1(): PASS only if every required setting is VISIBLE and: log_statement in {none, ddl}; log_min_duration_statement = -1; duration sampling off (log_min_duration_sample = -1 or log_statement_sample_rate = 0); log_transaction_sample_rate = 0; log_parameter_max_length_on_error = 0; debug_print_parse/rewritten/plan = off; if pgaudit is preloaded, pgaudit.log is none/empty and pgaudit.role empty; if auto_explain is preloaded, auto_explain.log_min_duration = -1; if pg_stat_statements is preloaded, NOT (track = all AND track_utility = on). An invisible required setting, or a preloaded unruled statement recorder (pg_stat_monitor, pg_store_plans, pg_qualstats), is INCONCLUSIVE; an unsafe value is FAIL. Only PASS closes OEP-1.
OEP1_PROBE_CONTRACT.why_log_statement_ddl_is_safe: log_statement = ddl logs top-level DDL a client sends. The mint's top-level statements are three SELECT set_config calls (not DDL) and one DO statement (not in the ddl class); the ALTER ROLE is EXECUTEd inside the DO block and is not a client statement.
OEP1_PROBE_CONTRACT.residual_disclosed: The posture can change between the probe and N11 (time of check vs time of use). No in-act re-read is authorized (AC-5 excludes other DB acts); the evidence's timestamp and the invalidation predicates bound it, and the owner sees the observation time at HC-1.
